task.name: Operate_flame_effects
task.when: Continuously while the flame-effect system is pressurized or lit

step.action: Keep the licensed operator and trained spotter at the effect continuously.
Keep people and combustible material outside the FAST-approved perimeter.
Continuously observe wind, flame direction, pressure, pilots, hoses, fittings, controls, and the audience boundary.
step.ifThen: IF wind picks up, the flame or heat can leave the approved zone, a leak or abnormal condition appears, or any Ranger, FAST, or ESD member requests shutdown, THEN stop firing and complete the approved emergency shutdown.

step.action: Fire the effect only on the licensed operator's command and within the approved operating limits.

passWhen.criterion: The effect was continuously attended by a licensed operator and trained spotter.
Every firing stayed within the approved operating limits.
Any shutdown condition caused immediate shutdown.
